    About this UI

    This is a placeholder shell — enough to confirm the Tauri webview and the Go backend talk to each other end to end. A real SPA (React + Vite is the planned stack) will replace this dist/ at a later phase. Until then the curl-friendly REST API is the primary interface; see README.md at the repo root for the endpoint tour.
